answer: A JSONL registry event log records publish, yank, deprecate, revoke, and moderate actions. Each record stores prev_hash (predecessor digest, 64 zeros at seq=1) and record_hash (SHA-256 of the record with record_hash omitted, canonical JSON). The writer opens O_APPEND and refuses replace/overwrite/truncate. A single-field edit of seq=3 is detected and named. A full re-chain verifies clean — an unanchored chain cannot prove original authorship. SUCCESS:IMP-0072

evidence.claim: Chain verification PASSES over a genuine five-action log in the same run that a single-field middle-record edit FAILS verification and names seq=3 (deprecate).
A rewrite attempt (replace/overwrite/truncate/rewrite_prefix) is rejected by the writer and existing prefix bytes do not move.

implementation.notes: command-center/events/EVENTS.jsonl is CC-0007's work-unit log and is absent on this tree; IMP-0072 ships a dedicated registry event log rather than overloading that file.

negative_controls.description: Untampered five-action log verifies clean in the same run as the middle-record edit (catalog negative control).
Writer replace/overwrite/truncate/rewrite_prefix raise AppendOnlyViolation; prefix bytes unchanged.

question_or_target: Record every publish, yank, deprecate, revoke and moderation action as an append-only event whose hash chains to its predecessor, so a silent retroactive edit of registry history is detectable by recomputing the chain.

residual_unknowns.claim: An unanchored hash chain cannot distinguish a fully re-chained rewrite (edit plus recompute of every downstream hash) from original history.
residual_unknowns.settling_experiment: Bind the head digest to an external anchor (signed checkpoint, independent replica, or WORM media) and re-run the re-chain forgery; detection requires the anchor, not the chain verifier alone.

reviewer.notes: Probe 2 edited seq=3 payload.message then recomputed every downstream prev_hash and record_hash. verify_log returned ok=True. Nothing in this verifier detects that forgery. Stated honestly: an unanchored chain cannot prove original authorship or detect a complete rewrite of history.
reviewer.requirement: Reviewer must attempt a re-chained forgery (edit plus recompute all downstream hashes) and record whether anything detects it, stating honestly what an unanchored chain cannot prove.

title: Append-only hash-chained registry event log
